ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels spanning approx. 75% of the visible surface, contrasted against low-intensity (black) pixel borders and mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones occupy the central regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black mottling and solid banding are localized along the entire trailing edge and distal tips. A prominent vertical black linear feature is positioned on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression located at the central convergence of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency jagged serration with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys across the length of the trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep from the median notch extending to acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of localized dark circular pixel patterns concentrated at the distal tips and along the lower ventral perimeter.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical black linear disruption on the right lobe; multiple faint horizontal and diagonal thin linear marks visible on the high-intensity white surfaces of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily irregular and serrated trailing edge boundary; prominent vertical linear pigmentation mark on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Single isolated dark focal spot on the white high-intensity field of the outer right lobe.
